meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆成可查证的步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把复杂目标落地成可执行步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break a goal into evidence-based steps and drive them in a loop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn complex goals into executable steps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先登记目标和成功标准,再把大目标拆成大量极小的步骤,进入一个带检查点的循环:一次只推进一个,每步都要从实际运行结果里留下可验证证据才继续。代码改动交给它派出的子代理编写、验证并分步提交。
howto.when: 当你说出「ulw-loop」「ulw」等关键词,或要求做分步留证、人工核验的检查点式长期执行时。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个项目拆成可逐项验证的步骤来执行。
say.note: 会先登记目标,建立细粒度待办清单。

say.text: 启动 ulw 目标循环,每完成一小步都记录证据再继续。
say.note: 只有证据合格才推进下一步。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 处理这个长期任务,代码改动交给子代理验证再提交。
say.note: 代码改动会被拆给子代理,验证通过才提交。

howto.what_en: Once loaded, Claude first registers the goal and criteria, then runs it as a checkpointed loop of tiny steps, one at a time, each backed by observable evidence; code edits go to subagents to verify and commit per unit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says `ulw-loop` or `ulw`, or asks for a durable, evidence-led execution with manual QA and checkpoints.

say_en.text: Run this project as an ulw-loop with verifiable steps.
say_en.note: It registers goals and builds a fine-grained checklist.

say_en.text: Start an ulw goal loop and record evidence for each small step.
say_en.note: Checklist advances only after evidence passes.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop for this long task; let subagents handle and verify code edits.
say_en.note: Code edits are delegated, tested, and committed per unit.
